caption: Push up progression for beginners: four honest steps from the wall to the floor. Own ten clean reps at one step, then climb. The wall is step one, not a shortcut. Save the ladder.

voiceover.text: Nobody fails push-ups. They start on the wrong rung.
The push-up has a staircase, and the wall is step one, not a shortcut.
Step one. Wall push-ups. Ten reps. Stand at arm's length, lower slow, press back.
Step two. Incline push-ups on a chair. Eight reps. Lower angle, more load.
Step three. Kneeling push-ups. Eight reps. One straight line from knees to head.
Step four. The full push-up. Six reps. Same shape, full length.
Move up when ten clean reps feel steady. Not before.
Every step on this ladder counts as strength. Which step are you on? Comment the number.
